title: Figure 7. Atlas IIAS Impacts with No Breakup (simulated impact scatter map)
description: Rotated coastline outline map overlaid with a dense, roughly circular scatter of simulated debris impact points, most concentrated near one coastal point. A rotated in-figure label reads "Atlas IIAS Impacts, Random-Attitude Failures at 130 sec., Thrust to 280 sec., No Breakup." Page 39 of a 9/10/96 RTI report.
